title: Rust Lock-Free SPMC Atomic Ring Buffer
description: Implement a bounded Single-Producer Multi-Consumer (SPMC) ring buffer using AtomicUsize and Acquire/Release memory ordering.
prompt:
You are an expert Rust systems engineer. Implement a lock-free Single-Producer Multi-Consumer (SPMC) ring buffer:

Requirements:
1. Define `pub struct SpmcRingBuffer<T>` with `pub fn new(capacity: usize) -> Self`.
2. Implement `pub fn push(&self, item: T) -> Result<(), T>` using `AtomicUsize` with `Ordering::Release`.
3. Implement `pub fn pop(&self) -> Option<T>` using `compare_exchange_weak` or `compare_exchange` with `Ordering::Acquire`.
4. When buffer is full, `push` returns `Err(item)`.
5. When buffer is empty, `pop` returns `None`.
6. Output ONLY the production struct inside a markdown block. DO NOT write unit tests or main.

constraints.name: no_unsafe_arbitrary
constraints.description: Do not declare unsafe public functions.
